profile.headline: Senior Electrical Technology Engineer at Brunswick Boat Group
profile.summary:
• Eight+ years of professional experience as an Electrical Engineer.
• Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering and Master of Science in Electrical Engineering.
• Experience in managing the integration of new technology concepts into recreational boats (from 16 foot sport boats to 65 foot yacht).
• Knowledge in RF communications, satellite communications systems, digital communications systems, antenna design, radar design, satellite remote sensing and digital signal processing. 
• Proficient in Matlab, multiSIM, and various 2D and 3D CAD software. Research experience includes: developing algorithms, programming and simulating in Matlab. 
• Solutions driven, good communication skills, strong organizational skills and attention to detail, as well as bilingual (English and Spanish). Electrical ABYC certified. Green Belt LSS certified.

Advanced Courses:
• Microwave Remote Sensing
• Radar Systems
• Satellite Communications
• Digital Communications
• Digital Signal Processing
• Antenna Design
• RF Communications
• Electromagnetic Theory

Skills:
• Matlab
• UniGraphics
• Multisim Electronic Workbench
• EMI/EMC
• STK
• Grounding and Bonding
• Object Oriented Languages: Java, C/C++
• Ansoft HFSS
• AutoCAD
• Assembly Language
• MathCAD
• Microsoft Project

Thesis Research: Microwave remote sensing was the primary concentration for thesis work. Main objective was to develop and tune an algorithm to be implemented as part of the rain rate retrieval algorithm for the Aquarious/SAC-D Microwave Radiometer (MWR). The algorithm was written in Matlab, and it was based upon the radiative transfer theory and statistical regressions. The algorithm was tuned and validated using data from a similar radiometer (WindSat).

positions.title: Senior Electrical Technology Engineer
positions.description:
• Manage the integration of new technology concepts into recreational vessel design including engineering, financial planning, tooling and production logistics.
• Lead electrical technology projects from ideation though production implementation, including charter creation, scheduling, budgeting, and technical expertise.
• Communicate and coordinate efforts with suppliers to develop and implement new products and systems within design requirements, timing and budget constraints.
• Develop test plans and coordinate with test lab to evaluate new electrical products or systems.
• Develop innovative solutions to carry out conceptual design intend into an engineered solution for production.
• Act as the lead electrical engineer for electronics and electrical systems of the following areas: navigational electronics, audio/video systems, lighting, and new technologies.
• Support electrical model change activities and communicate changes to new product development team.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
Current responsibilities include:
• Designed the electrical system for new product development (recreational vessels raging from 16 ft to 65 ft).
• Designed the power distribution systems of the vessel (AC, DC, generator, inverter).
• Generated AC and DC load calculations.
• Followed industry regulations and standards in entire electrical system.
• Worked in parallel with other engineering disciplines (naval, structural, mechanical, propulsion).
• Integrated off the shelf commercial products to the electrical system of the boat. 
• Modified and approve 2-D drawing schematics.
• Utilized 3-D software (Unigraphics) to review 3-D model of developing product.
• Provided support and direction to the electrical assembly team while prototype is been built.
• Provided support to the assembly plants on the electrical system of vessels that are in production.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
• Tested, validated, and troubleshot electrical systems on yachts.
• Provided technical expertise to assembly and customer service groups.
• Provided leadership on the design and implementation for special and innovative projects executed by the assembly plant.
• Developed and maintained standard operating procedures for electrical systems in yachts.
• Modified existing electrical system documentation as needed in order to submit engineering change request.
• Created and updated customized special instructions projects database.
• Managed special instructions projects for yachts with a diversified technical team.
